business_process: Operations Cloud case management (customer service and agent workspace)
description: Customers' agents create, route, work, and close service cases; about 6 million new cases a day across 14 cells
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: 99.95% Enterprise SLA (about 22 minutes of downtime a month) and service credits; customers' own customer service stops; 48-hour and 24-hour contract incident clocks run in parallel with any security outage
manual_workaround: Customers fall back to email and phone queues; read-only status page; no workaround inside the product
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider A; managed DNS provider; CDN and DDoS protection service
dependent_people_or_facilities: Site reliability engineers (on call); 14 cells in two regions
quantified_impact_basis: Service credits at the MSA's 25% tier on about $300 million monthly Operations Cloud subscription revenue for Enterprise-tier tenants in a day-long outage of every cell (about $31 million), plus about $1.5 million response and overtime cost and about $6 million expected renewal losses
acquisition_dependency: AQ-01 exports depend on BP-01 data (see BP-17)
single_points_of_failure: Single managed DNS provider; Cell 4 failover not proven within RTO

business_process: Field service scheduling and mobile dispatch
description: Scheduling and dispatch of customers' field technicians through the mobile app and routing engine
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customers' technicians cannot see work orders; some customers (utilities, telecom field crews) use dispatch for outage restoration, so delays have indirect safety effects
manual_workaround: Mobile app offline mode caches the day's jobs; dispatchers phone technicians
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider A; push notification services; mapping and routing service
quantified_impact_basis: Service credits on about $78 million monthly field service revenue (about $7.8 million) plus about $1.7 million expected contraction

business_process: Employee service desk (IT and HR service management for customers' workforces)
description: Customers' employees raise IT and HR requests; customers' service desks work them
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customers' internal operations slow but have email fallbacks; same SLA as BP-01
manual_workaround: Customers' email and phone service desks
quantified_impact_basis: Service credits on about $52 million monthly employee service desk revenue (about $5.2 million) plus about $0.8 million expected contraction

business_process: Customer sign-in, SSO federation, and API access
description: Customer identity service, SSO federation with customers' identity providers, and the API gateway that every integration uses
process_owner: Director of Identity and Access Management
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: No customer can reach BP-01 to BP-03 without it; API integrations (about 2.4 billion calls a day) fail; impact is counted in BP-01 to BP-03 and is not additive
manual_workaround: None (no sign-in path without the service)
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider A; managed DNS provider
quantified_impact_basis: Not additive: the outage cost appears in BP-01 to BP-03
single_points_of_failure: Customer identity service runs in one primary region with a warm standby

business_process: AI Assist (generative AI features in the Operations Cloud)
description: Case summaries, reply drafts, knowledge article drafts, and agent actions for about 2,300 customers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Agents can work without AI Assist; contract commitments for the AI add-on are best-effort except for 140 Enterprise AI contracts with credits
manual_workaround: Agents write replies and summaries manually
dependent_third_parties: Three generative AI model providers (each feature uses one); Cloud provider A
quantified_impact_basis: Service credits on AI add-on contracts (about $0.6 million) plus lost agent productivity at customers raising complaints (about $0.3 million)
single_points_of_failure: Each AI Assist feature depends on a single model provider; no tested failover between providers

business_process: Data Cloud analytics and customer data platform (SL-2)
description: Customer analytics dashboards, data pipelines from the Operations Cloud, and audience segments for about 3,100 customers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customers use dashboards daily but most decisions can wait a day; pipelines can replay from the Operations Cloud event log
manual_workaround: Customers use Operations Cloud standard reports
quantified_impact_basis: Service credits on about $55 million monthly Data Cloud revenue (about $2.3 million) plus pipeline replay cost (about $0.5 million)

description: Virtual agents that answer customers' consumer chats and calls and hand off to human agents in the Operations Cloud
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: When virtual agents stop, customers' human agents receive the full volume; 1,150 shared customers; AQ-01 contracts have a 99.9% SLA
manual_workaround: Route all contacts to human agents in the Operations Cloud
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider B; telephony carrier; speech-to-text provider; AI model provider
quantified_impact_basis: Service credits on about $21 million monthly Conversational AI revenue (about $1.1 million) plus customer overtime claims (about $0.5 million)
acquisition_dependency: AQ-01 runs outside the landing zone with its own identity provider and on-call rotation
single_points_of_failure: Separate identity provider and cloud organization; recovery not included in enterprise DR tests

description: Operations Cloud for 45 federal civilian agencies in the FedRAMP Moderate boundary
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Agency mission support; agency contracts and the FedRAMP authorization require contingency planning and testing; outage reports go to agencies
manual_workaround: Agencies fall back to email and phone
dependent_people_or_facilities: Government Edition operations team (U.S. persons only)
quantified_impact_basis: Contract credits on about $9 million monthly Government Edition revenue (about $0.9 million) plus reporting and response cost (about $0.2 million)
single_points_of_failure: Recovery region capacity reserved for one region only

description: Source hosting, CI/CD pipelines, artifact registry, and build signing for all products
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Without the pipeline the company cannot ship security fixes; emergency changes need a break-glass deployment path
manual_workaround: Break-glass deployment from a signed artifact cache, approved by the CTO
dependent_third_parties: Source hosting and CI service; artifact registry
quantified_impact_basis: About 4,300 engineers partly idle (about $0.5 million a day) plus delayed releases (about $0.1 million)
acquisition_dependency: AQ-01 uses its own pipelines with static keys (SYS-09)
single_points_of_failure: Single source hosting and CI service

description: 24x7 SOC, SIEM, EDR, cloud threat detection, and the incident process
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Loss of detection during an attack widens exposure; FedRAMP continuous monitoring and customer incident clocks depend on it
manual_workaround: Cloud provider native alerts routed to on-call; EDR console direct
dependent_people_or_facilities: SOC analysts in three U.S. sites
quantified_impact_basis: Low direct cost; impact is the risk of an undetected incident (counted in P01, not here)
acquisition_dependency: AQ-01 cloud audit logs are not in the SIEM
single_points_of_failure: Single SIEM SaaS with no secondary log pipeline

description: Support ticketing, telephony, chat, and the tenant access tool used to troubleshoot customer tenants
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Support response-time commitments in Enterprise contracts; customers need support most during platform incidents
manual_workaround: Status page and email updates; incident commander's customer bulletins
dependent_third_parties: Support ticketing SaaS; contact center telephony provider; follow-the-sun support vendor
dependent_people_or_facilities: About 2,100 support and success staff; support vendor agents
quantified_impact_basis: Response-time credits and escalations (about $1.4 million) plus overtime and vendor surge fees (about $0.8 million)
single_points_of_failure: Single telephony provider for the contact center

description: Subscription billing, invoicing, payment processing, and collections
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Cash can wait several days; month-end invoicing window tightens MTD to 48 hours
manual_workaround: Manual invoices for the top 200 customers
dependent_third_parties: Billing SaaS; payment processor; ERP SaaS
quantified_impact_basis: Deferred cash (about $17 million a day is invoiced) costs about $0.6 million a month in working capital per day of delay, plus rework (about $0.2 million)

description: General ledger, consolidation, and SEC filings, including any Form 8-K
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: SEC filing deadlines; during the quarter-end close window the MTD drops to 48 hours
manual_workaround: Extracts from the ERP's last export; outside filing agent
quantified_impact_basis: Overtime and outside advisor cost; regulatory impact dominates

description: Payroll for 12,000 employees, benefits, and HR records
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Pay dates; state wage payment laws
manual_workaround: Repeat the prior payroll with adjustments
quantified_impact_basis: Penalties and overtime for late pay (about $0.3 million)

description: Pipeline management, quoting, and marketing campaigns
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Deals can wait days; quarter-end bookings window raises the impact
quantified_impact_basis: Delayed bookings near quarter end (about $0.7 million expected slippage a day)

description: Email, chat, documents, and video for 12,000 employees
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Incident coordination and customer communications depend on it; out-of-band tools exist for incidents
quantified_impact_basis: Lost productivity across 12,000 employees (about $1.2 million a day at 10% loss)

description: Scheduled exports, connectors, partner integrations, and the nightly export to AQ-01 for shared customers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customers' downstream systems and AQ-01 models depend on exports; a confidentiality failure here is a regulatory event (P08 scenario)
manual_workaround: Customers re-run exports later; AQ-01 serves from its last copy
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider A; Cloud provider B
quantified_impact_basis: Service credits and integration rework (about $1.3 million)
acquisition_dependency: The shared export bucket sits in AQ-01's cloud organization
single_points_of_failure: Shared export bucket outside the landing zone
